purpose: Offline fixtures for bfinance.screener, the package's backbone fundamentals source. Every file is a verbatim recording of a live screener.in response on the date above, except where trim_rule says otherwise. Trimmed regions are listed per file.
robots: screener.in/robots.txt disallows /user/*, /*?q=, /*?sort=, /*?limit=, /*?page= and /company/source/quarter/*. company_itc.html.trim_rule: verbatim sub-trees re-wrapped in a bare <html><body>, with the inter-tag indentation stripped from every kept text node (no text content altered; the parser reads every value through get_text(strip=True), so this is behaviour-neutral): div[data-company-id] verbatim (id resolver); h1 verbatim (company name); div.company-info verbatim (about + links + ul#top-ratios); section#peers verbatim minus 52 a.tag.hidden and 3 of the visible #benchmarks chips (2 kept); the four /market/ crumbs kept in full; div.pros verbatim; div.cons verbatim; all 4 table.ranges-table elements kept verbatim; section#quarters: header + visible table verbatim, columns cut to the trailing 2 period columns, all data rows kept; section#profit-loss: header + visible table verbatim, columns cut to the trailing 2 period columns, all data rows kept; section#balance-sheet: header + visible table verbatim, columns cut to the trailing 2 period columns, all data rows kept; section#cash-flow: header + visible table verbatim, columns cut to the trailing 2 period columns, all data rows kept; section#ratios: header + visible table verbatim, columns cut to the trailing 2 period columns, all data rows kept; section#shareholding verbatim (quarterly + yearly tables); columns cut to the trailing 2 of the quarterly table and the trailing 4 of the yearly table - different windows on purpose, so a parser that reads both from the same table cannot pass; all rows kept; section#documents: .concalls ul li cut to the newest 1, .annual-reports a cut to 1, .credit-ratings a cut to 1; section#documents (attributes + the kept sub-lists). Dropped: <head>, top nav, sidebar, footer, section#chart, section#insights, hidden duplicate statement tables, and all <script>/modal markup.
company_itc.html.notes: The consolidated page is NOT byte-stable between fetches (per-request CSRF tokens, ids and ad markup move); only the parsed values are stable. Its section id sequence is identical to the TCS recording - that is what the genericity test asserts.
